description: Fragment 1 of 2 of a single AES-128-GCM sealed TELEMETRY message (docs/encryption.md sections 2 and 5). The message is sealed ONCE, whole, and only then cut into ESP-NOW sized fragments, so the 16-octet tag lives at the end of fragment 1 and neither fragment can be opened on its own. The AAD is the canonicalized LOGICAL header: FRAGMENTED cleared, fragment_index 0, fragment_count 1, and payload_size set to the full 236-octet ciphertext-and-tag size. Because every field that re-fragmentation changes is excluded from the AAD, the tag is identical no matter how the message was cut, which is what lets a gateway reassemble from one transport and re-fragment onto another without holding the key. btp::decode() does not verify the tag; this vector proves the framing and gives an implementation the exact octets to reassemble and open.
